title: ذِكْرُ الْبَيَانِ بِأَنَّ ثُمَامَةَ رُبِطَ إِلَى سَارِيَةٍ فِي وَقْتِ أَسْرِهِ
chain_en: ʿUmar b. Muḥammad al-Hamdānī > ʿĪsá b. Ḥammād > al-Layth > Saʿīd al-Maqburī > Abū Hurayrah
body_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent some horsemen to Najd. They captured a man. He was from the tribe of Banu Hanifa and was called Thumama b. Uthal. He was the chief of the people of Yamama. People bound him with one of the pillars of the mosque. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came out to (see) him. He said: O Thumama, what do you think? He replied: Muhammad, I have good opinion of you. If you kill me, you will kill a person who has spilt blood. If you do me a favour, you will do a favour to a grateful person. If you want wealth, ask and you will get what you will demand. The Messenger of Allah (may peace be pon him) lefthim (in this condition) for two days, (and came to him again) and said: What do you think, O Thumama? He replied: What I have already told you. If you do a favour, you will do a favour to a grateful person. If you kill me, you will kill a person who has spilt blood. If you want wealth, ask and you will get what you will demand. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ left him until the next day when he (came to him again) and said: What do you think, O Thumama? He replied: What I have already told you. If you do me a favour, you will do a favour to a grateful person. If you kill me, you will kill a person who has spilt blood. If you want wealth ask and you will get what you will demand. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Set Thumama free. He went to a palm-grove near the mosque and took a bath. Then he entered the mosque and said: I bear testimony (to the truth) that there is no god but Allah and I testify that Muhammad is His bondman and His messenger. O Muhammad, by Allah, there was no face on the earth more hateful to me than your face, but (now) your face has become to me the dearest of all faces. By Allah, there was no religion more hateful to me than your religion, but (now) your religion has become the dearest of all religions to me. By Allah, there was no city more hateful to me than your city, but (now) your city has become the dearest of all cities to me. Your horsemen captured me when I intended going for Umra. Now what is your opinion (in the matter)? The Messenger of Allah ﷺ announced good tidings to him and told him to go on 'Umra. When he reached Mecca, somebody said to him: Have you changed your religion? He said: No! I have rather embraced Islam with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. By Allah, you will not get a single grain of wheat from Yamama until it is permitted by the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. (Using translation from Muslim 1764a)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْهَمْدَانِيُّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ
body: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يَقُولُ بَعَثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ خَيْلًا قِبَلَ نَجْدٍ فَجَاءَتْ بِرَجُلٍ مِنْ بَنِي حَنِيفَةَ يُقَالُ لَهُ ثُمَامَةُ بْنُ أُثَالٍ سَيِّدُ أَهْلِ الْيَمَامَةِ فَرَبَطُوهُ بِسَارِيَةٍ مِنْ سَوَارِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَخَرَجَ إِلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ «مَا عِنْدَكَ يَا ثُمَامَةُ»؟ قَالَ عِنْدِي يَا مُحَمَّدُ خَيْرٌ إِنْ تَقْتُلْنِي تَقْتُلْ ذَا دَمٍ وَإِنْ تُنْعِمْ تُنْعِمْ عَلَى شَاكِرٍ وَإِنْ كُنْتَ تُرِيدُ الْمَالَ فَسَلْ تُعْطَ مِنْهُ مَا شِئْتَ فَتَرَكَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ حَتَّى كَانَ الْغَدُ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهُ «مَا عِنْدَكَ يَا ثُمَامَةُ»؟ قَالَ مَا قُلْتُ لَكَ إِنْ تُنْعِمْ تُنْعِمْ عَلَى شَاكِرٍ وَإِنْ تَقْتُلْ تَقْتُلْ ذَا دَمٍ وَإِنْ كُنْتَ تُرِيدُ الْمَالَ فَسَلْ تُعْطَ مِنْهُ مَا شِئْتَ فَتَرَكَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ حَتَّى كَانَ بَعْدَ الْغَدِ فَقَالَ لَهُ «مَا عِنْدَكَ يَا ثُمَامَةُ»؟ فَقَالَ عِنْدِي مَا قُلْتُ لَكَ إِنْ تُنْعِمْ تُنْعِمْ عَلَى شَاكِرٍ وَإِنْ تَقْتُلْ تَقْتُلْ ذَا دَمٍ وَإِنْ كُنْتَ تُرِيدُ الْمَالَ فَسَلْ تُعْطَ مِنْهُ مَا شِئْتَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «أَطْلِقُوا ثُمَامَةَ» فَانْطَلَقَ إِلَى نَخْلٍ قَرِيبٍ مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ فَاغْتَسَلَ ثُمَّ دَخَلَ الْمَسْجِدَ فَقَالَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ يَا مُحَمَّدُ وَاللَّهِ مَا كَانَ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ وَجْهٌ أَبْغَضَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ وَجْهِكَ فَقَدْ أَصْبَحَ وَجْهُكَ أَحَبَّ الْوُجُوهِ كُلِّهَا إِلَيَّ وَاللَّهِ مَا كَانَ مِنْ دِينٍ أَبْغَضَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ دِينِكَ فَقَدْ أَصْبَحَ دِينَكَ أَحَبَّ الدِّينِ كُلِّهِ إِلَيَّ وَاللَّهِ مَا كَانَ بَلَدٌ أَبْغَضَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ بَلَدِكَ فَقَدَ أَصْبَحَ بَلَدُكَ أَحَبَّ الْبِلَادِ إِلَيَّ وَإِنَّ خَيْلَكَ أَخَذَتْنِي وَأَنَا أُرِيدُ الْعُمْرَةَ فَمَاذَا تَرَى؟ فَبَشَّرَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَأَمَرَهُ أَنْ يَعْتَمِرَ فَلَمَّا قَدِمَ مَكَّةَ قَالَ لَهُ قَائِلٌ صَبَوْتَ؟ قَالَ لَا وَلَكِنْ أَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ مُحَمَّدٍ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَلَا وَاللَّهِ لَا تَأْتِيكُمْ مِنَ الْيَمَامَةِ حَبَّةُ حِنْطَةٍ حَتَّى يَأْذَنَ فِيهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ

title: ذِكْرُ الِاسْتِحْبَابِ لِلْكَافِرِ إِذَا أَسْلَمَ أَنْ يَكُونَ اغْتِسَالُهُ بِمَاءٍ وَسِدْرٍ
chain_en: ʿUmar b. Muḥammad al-Hamdānī > ʿAmr b. ʿAlī > Yaḥyá al-Qaṭṭān > Sufyān > al-Aghar b. al-Ṣabbāḥ > Khalīfah b. Ḥuṣayn > Qays b. ʿĀṣim
body_en: It was narrated from Qais bin 'Asim that he accepted Islam, and the Prophet commanded him to perform Ghusl with water and lotus leaves. (Using translation from Nasāʾī 188)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْهَمْدَانِيُّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ يَحْيَى الْقَطَّانِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنِ الْأَغَرِّ بْنِ الصَّبَّاحِ عَنْ خَلِيفَةَ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ
body: «أَنَّهُ أَسْلَمَ فَأَمَرَهُ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ أَنْ يَغْتَسِلَ بِمَاءٍ وَسِدْرٍ»

body_en: [Machine] About the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "Nothing makes water impure."

title: ذِكْرُ الْخَبَرِ الْمُدْحِضِ قَوْلَ مَنْ زَعَمَ أَنَّ هَذَا الْخَبَرَ وَرَدَ فِي الْمِيَاهِ الْجَارِيَةِ دُونَ الْمِيَاهِ الرَّاكِدَةِ
chain_en: al-Ḥasan b. Sufyān > Ḥibbān b. Mūsá > ʿAbdullāh > Sufyān > Simāk b. Ḥarb > ʿIkrimah > Ibn ʿAbbās
body_en: [Machine] "A woman from the wives of the Prophet ﷺ performed ghusl from janabah (post-sexual impurity). Then the Prophet ﷺ came and performed wudu from the leftover water. She said to him, and he said, 'Verily, nothing makes the water impure.'"
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ سُفْيَانَ حَدَّثَنَا حِبَّانُ بْنُ مُوسَى أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ
body: أَنَّ امْرَأَةً مِنْ أَزْوَاجِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ اغْتَسَلَتْ مِنْ جَنَابَةٍ فَجَاءَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ يَتَوَضَّأُ مِنْ فَضْلِهَا فَقَالَتْ لَهُ فَقَالَ «إِنَّ الْمَاءَ لَا يُنَجِّسُهُ شَيْءٌ»

title: ذِكْرُ الْخَبَرِ الْمُدْحِضِ قَوْلَ مَنْ نَفَى جَوَازَ الْوُضُوءِ بِمَاءِ الْبَحْرِ
chain_en: al-Faḍl b. al-Ḥubāb al-Jumaḥī > al-Qaʿnabī > Mālik > Ṣafwān b. Sulaym > Saʿīd b. Salamah from Āl Banī al-Azraq > al-Mughīrah b. Abū Burdah / from Banī ʿAbd al-Dār > Abū Hurayrah
body_en: [Machine] Narrated by Al-Qa'nabi from Malik from Safwan ibn Suleiman from Sa'id ibn Salamah from the descendants of Banu Al-Azraq that Al-Mughirah ibn Abi Burdah, who was from the descendants of Banu Abdud-Dar, informed him that he heard Abu Hurairah say: A man asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ : O Messenger of Allah, we ride on the sea and carry with us a small amount of water, so if we perform ablution with it, we become thirsty. Should we perform ablution with the water of the sea? The Prophet ﷺ  replied, "Its water is pure, and its dead animals are lawful to eat."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا الْفَضْلُ بْنُ الْحُبَابِ الْجُمَحِيُّ قَالَ
body: حَدَّثَنَا الْقَعْنَبِيُّ عَنْ مَالِكٍ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ مِنْ آلِ بَنِي الْأَزْرَقِ أَنَّ الْمُغِيرَةَ بْنَ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ وَهُوَ مِنْ بَنِي عَبْدِ الدَّارِ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يَقُولُ سَأَلَ رَجُلٌ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّا نَرْكَبُ الْبَحْرَ وَنَحْمِلُ مَعَنْا الْقَلِيلَ مِنَ الْمَاءِ فَإِنْ تَوَضَّأْنَا بِهِ عَطِشْنَا أَفَنَتَوَضَّأُ مِنْ مَاءِ الْبَحْرِ؟ فَقَالَ «هُوَ الطُّهُورُ مَاؤُهُ الْحِلُّ مَيْتَتُهُ»

title: ذِكْرُ الْخَبَرِ الْمُدْحِضِ، قَوْلَ مَنْ زَعَمَ أَنَّ هَذِهِ السُّنَّةَ تَفَرَّدَ بِهَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ
chain_en: Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman al-Sāmī > Aḥmad b. Ḥanbal > Abū al-Qāsim b. Abū al-Zinād > Isḥāq b. Ḥāzim > Ibn Miqsam / ʿUbaydullāh > Jābir
body_en: Its water is pure (and Purification) and its 'dead meat' is permissible (to eat). (Using translation from Nasāʾī 4350)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ السَّامِيُّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حَنْبَلٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْقَاسِمِ بْنُ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ عَنِ ابْنِ مِقْسَمٍ يَعْنِي عُبَيْدَ اللَّهِ عَنْ جَابِرٍ
body: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ سُئِلَ عَنْ مَاءِ الْبَحْرِ فَقَالَ «هُوَ الطُّهُورُ مَاؤُهُ الْحِلُّ مَيْتَتُهُ»

title: ذِكْرُ إِبَاحَةِ الِاغْتِسَالِ مِنَ الْمَاءِ الَّذِي خَالَطَهُ بَعْضُ الْمَأْكُولِ، مَا لَمْ يَغْلِبْ عَلَى الْمَاءِ كَثْرَتُهُ
chain_en: al-Ḥusayn b. Muḥammad b. Muṣʿab
body_en: It was narrated from Umm Hani' that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed Ghusl, he and Maimunah from a single vessel, a bowl in which there were traces of dough. (Using translation from Nasāʾī 240)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُصْعَبٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُشْكَانَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ الْحُبَابِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ عَنْ أُمِّ هَانِئٍ
body: «أَنَّ مَيْمُونَةَ وَرَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ اغْتَسَلَا فِي قَصْعَةٍ فِيهَا أَثَرُ الْعَجِينِ»

title: ذِكْرُ مَا يَعْمَلُ الْمَرْءُ عِنْدَ وُقُوعِ مَا لَا نَفْسَ لَهُ تَسِيلُ فِي مَائِهِ أَوْ مَرَقَتِهِ
chain_en: Muḥammad b. Isḥāq b. Khuzaymah > Ziyād b. Yaḥyá al-Ḥassānī > Bishr b. al-Mufaḍḍal > Ibn ʿAjlān > Saʿīd al-Maqburī > Abū Hurayrah
body_en: when a fly alights in anyone’s vessel, he should plunge it all in, for in one of its wings there is a disease, and in the other is a cure. It prevents the wing of it is which there is a cure, so plunge it all in (the vessel). (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3844)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ خُزَيْمَةَ حَدَّثَنَا زِيَادُ بْنُ يَحْيَى الْحَسَّانِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْمُفَضَّلِ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عَجْلَانَ عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ
body: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِذَا وَقَعَ الذُّبَابُ فِي إِنَاءِ أَحَدِكُمْ فَإِنَّ فِي أَحَدِ جَنَاحَيْهِ دَاءً وَفِي الْآخَرِ شِفَاءً وَإِنَّهُ يَتَّقِي بِجَنَاحِهِ الَّذِي فِيهِ الدَّاءُ فَلْيَغْمِسْهُ كُلَّهُ ثُمَّ لِيَنْزِعْهُ»

title: ذِكْرُ الْأَمْرِ بِغَمْسِ الذُّبَابِ فِي الْإِنَاءِ إِذَا وَقَعَ فِيهِ، إِذْ أَحَدُ جَنَاحَيْهِ دَاءٌ وَالْآخَرُ شِفَاءٌ
chain_en: Abū Yaʿlá > Abū Khaythamah > Yaḥyá al-Qaṭṭān > Ibn Abū Dhiʾb > Saʿīd b. Khālid > Abū Salamah b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman > Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī
body_en: [Machine] Concerning the Prophet ﷺ, he said, "If a fly falls into one of your containers, then dip it fully in, for indeed in its one wing there is a disease and in the other wing there is a cure."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو يَعْلَى قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَيْثَمَةَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى الْقَطَّانُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ
body: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «إِذَا وَقَعَ الذُّبَابُ فِي إِنَاءِ أَحَدِكُمْ فَامْقُلُوهُ فَإِنَّ فِي أَحَدِ جَنَاحَيْهِ دَاءً وَفِي الْآخَرِ دَوَاءً»

title: ذِكْرُ خَبَرٍ يَدْحَضُ، قَوْلَ مَنْ زَعَمَ أَنَّ الْمَاءَ الْمُغْتَسَلَ بِهِ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ إِذَا كَانَ رَاكِدًا يَنْجُسُ بَعْدَ أَنْ يَكُونَ قَلِيلًا، لَا يَكُونُ عَشْرًا فِي عَشَرٍ
chain_en: ʿUmar b. Ismāʿīl b. Abū Ghaylān al-Thaqafī > ʿUthmān b. Abū Shaybah > Abū al-Aḥwaṣ > Simāk b. Ḥarb > ʿIkrimah > Ibn ʿAbbās
body_en: One of the wives of the Prophet ﷺ took a bath from a large bowl. The Prophet ﷺ wanted to perform ablution or take from the water left over. She said to him: O Prophet of Allah, verily I was sexually defiled. The Prophet said: Water not defiled. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 68)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي غَيْلَانَ الثَّقَفِيُّ بِبَغْدَادَ حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْأَحْوَصِ عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ
body: اغْتَسَلَ بَعْضُ أَزْوَاجِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ مِنْ جَفْنَةٍ فَجَاءَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ يَغْتَسِلُ مِنْهَا أَوْ يَتَوَضَّأُ فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي كُنْتُ جُنُبًا فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ «إِنَّ الْمَاءَ لَا يُجْنِبُ»

title: ذِكْرُ أَحَدِ التَّخْصِيصَيْنِ اللَّذَيْنِ يَخُصَّانِ عُمُومَ الْخَبَرِ الَّذِي ذَكَرْنَاهُ
chain_en: al-Ḥasan b. Sufyān > Abū Bakr b. Abū Shaybah > Abū Usāmah > al-Walīd b. Kathīr > Muḥammad b. Jaʿfar b. al-Zubayr > ʿAbdullāh b. ʿAbdullāh > Abāh ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUmar
body_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked about water and how some animals and carnivorous beasts might drink from it. He said: 'If the water is more than two Qullahs, it will not carry filth.'[1] [1]It comes with some explanation in Sunan At Timidhi 'Abdah (one of the narrators) said: "Muhammad bin Ishaq said: 'A Qullah refers to Jirar (These are two nouns describing large casks that are used to hold water), and a Qullah is the thing that drinking water is held in."' At-Tirmidhi said: "This is the saying of Ash Shafa'i, Ahmad and Ishaq. They say that when the water is two Qullahs then nothing makes it impure, as long as it does not change its smell, and its taste. And they say, it is approximately fifty Qirbahs (waterskins)." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 52)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ سُفْيَانَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَهُمْ أَنَّ أَبَاهُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ حَدَّثَهُمْ
body: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ سُئِلَ عَنِ الْمَاءِ وَمَا يَنُوبُهُ مِنَ الدَّوَابِّ وَالسِّبَاعِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِذَا كَانَ الْمَاءُ قُلَّتَيْنِ لَمْ يُنَجِّسْهُ شَيْءٌ»

title: ذِكْرُ الزَّجْرِ عَنْ أَنْ يَبُولَ الْمَرْءُ فِي الْمَاءِ الَّذِي لَا يَجْرِي، إِذَا كَانَ ذَلِكَ دُونَ قُلَّتَيْنِ
chain_en: Ibn Qutaybah > Yazīd b. Mawhab > al-Layth > Abū al-Zubayr > Jābir
body_en: The Messenger of Allah forbade urinating into standing water. (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 343)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ قُتَيْبَةَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ مَوْهَبٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ جَابِرٍ
body: عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ «أَنَّهُ نَهَى عَنْ أَنْ يُبَالَ فِي الْمَاءِ الرَّاكِدِ»

title: ذِكْرُ الزَّجْرِ عَنِ الْبَوْلِ فِي الْمَاءِ الَّذِي دُونَ الْقُلَّتَيْنِ ثُمَّ الْوُضُوءِ مِنْهُ
chain_en: ʿAbdullāh b. Muḥammad al-Azdī > Isḥāq b. Ibrāhīm > ʿĪsá b. Yūnus > ʿAwf > Muḥammad > Abū Hurayrah
body_en: the Prophet said: "Let none of you urinate [in still water, then perform Wudu with it."1 (Using translation from Tirmidhī 68)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْأَزْدِيُّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ عَنْ عَوْفٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ
body: عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «لَا يَبُولَنَّ أَحَدُكُمْ فِي الْمَاءِ الدَّائِمِ ثُمَّ يَتَوَضَّأُ مِنْهُ»

title: ذِكْرُ الزَّجْرِ عَنِ اغْتِسَالِ الْجُنُبِ فِي أَقَلَّ مِنَ الْقُلَّتَيْنِ مِنَ الْمَاءِ حَذَرَ نَجَاسَةٍ عَلَى بَدَنِهِ إِنْ بَقِيَتْ
chain_en: ʿAbdullāh b. Muḥammad b. Salm > Ḥarmalah b. Yaḥyá > Ibn Wahb > ʿAmr b. al-Ḥārith > Bukayr b. al-Ashaj > Abū al-Sāʾib a freed slave of Hishām b. Zuhrah > Abū Hurayrah
body_en: Abu Sa'ib, the freed slave of Hisham bin Zuhrah, told him that he heard Abu Hurairah say: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'No one of you should bathe in standing water when he is sexually impure.'" He (Abu Sa'ib) said: "What should he do, O Abu Hurairah?" He said: "Let him take some out (and pour it over himself)." (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 605)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَلْمٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ الْأَشَجِّ أَنَّ أَبَا السَّائِبِ مَوْلَى هِشَامِ بْنِ زُهْرَةَ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يَقُولُ
body: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَا يَغْتَسِلُ أَحَدُكُمْ فِي الْمَاءِ الدَّائِمِ وَهُوَ جُنُبٌ» فَقَالُوا كَيْفَ نَفْعَلُ يَا أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ؟ قَالَ «يَتَنَاوَلُهُ تَنَاوُلًا»

title: ذِكْرُ الْخَبَرِ الدَّالِّ عَلَى صِحَّةِ مَا تَأَوَّلْنَا الْمَاءَ مِنَ اللَّذَيْنِ ذَكَرْنَاهُمَا فِي الْبَابَيْنِ الْمُتَقَدِّمَيْنِ
chain_en: al-Ḥasan b. Sufyān > Abū Bakr b. Abū Shaybah > Abū Usāmah > al-Walīd b. Kathīr > Muḥammad b. ʿAbbād b. Jaʿfar > ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUmar from his father
body_en: [Machine] "The Prophet ﷺ was asked about water and what can pollute it from animals. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ replied, 'If the water is two containers full, then nothing contaminates it.'"
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ سُفْيَانَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ كَثِيرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبَّادِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ
body: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ سُئِلَ عَنِ الْمَاءِ وَمَا يَنُوبُهُ مِنَ السِّبَاعِ وَالدَّوَابِّ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِذَا كَانَ الْمَاءُ قُلَّتَيْنِ لَمْ يُنَجِّسْهُ شَيْءٌ»

title: ذِكْرُ الزَّجْرِ عَنْ أَنْ يَبُولَ الْمَرْءُ فِي الْمَاءِ الَّذِي دُونَ الْقُلَّتَيْنِ، وَمَنْ نِيَّتُهُ الِاغْتِسَالُ مِنْهُ بَعْدَهُ
chain_en: Ibrāhīm b. Abū Umayyah Biṭarasūs > Ḥāmid b. Yaḥyá al-Balkhī > Sufyān > Abū al-Zinād > Mūsá b. Abū ʿUthmān from his father > Abū Hurayrah
body_en: You should not pass urine in stagnant water which is not flowing then (you may need to) wash in it. (Using translation from Bukhārī 239)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ أَبِي أُمَيَّةَ بِطَرَسُوسَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَامِدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى الْبَلْخِيُّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ
body: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَا يَبُولَنَّ أَحَدُكُمْ فِي الْمَاءِ الدَّائِمِ الَّذِي لَا يَجْرِي ثُمَّ يَغْتَسِلُ مِنْهُ»

title: ذِكْرُ الزَّجْرِ عَنْ بَوْلِ الْمَرْءِ فِي الْمُغْتَسَلِ الَّذِي لَا مَجْرَى لَهُ
chain_en: al-Ḥasan b. Sufyān > Ḥibbān b. Mūsá > ʿAbdullāh > Maʿmar > Ashʿath > al-Ḥasan > ʿAbdullāh b. al-Mughaffal
body_en: [Machine] The Prophet ﷺ  forbade a man from urinating in his bath, as most whisperings originate from it.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ سُفْيَانَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حِبَّانُ بْنُ مُوسَى قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ عَنْ أَشْعَثَ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْمُغَفَّلِ
body: «أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ نَهَى أَنْ يَبُولَ الرَّجُلُ فِي مُغْتَسَلِهِ فَإِنَّ عَامَّةَ الْوَسْوَاسِ يَكُونُ مِنْهُ»

title: ذِكْرُ الزَّجْرِ عَنِ الْبَوْلِ فِي الْمَاءِ الدَّائِمِ الَّذِي دُونَ الْقُلَّتَيْنِ، إِذَا أَرَادَ الْبَائِلُ الْوُضُوءَ أَوِ الشُّرْبَ مِنْهُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ
chain_en: Muḥammad b. Isḥāq b. Khuzaymah > Yūnus b. ʿAbd al-Aʿlá > Anas b. ʿIyāḍ > al-Ḥārith b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Abū Dhubāb > ʿAṭāʾ b. Mīnāʾ > Abū Hurayrah
body_en: the Prophet said: "Let none of you urinate [in still water, then perform Wudu with it."1 (Using translation from Tirmidhī 68)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ خُزَيْمَةَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْأَعْلَى قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ عِيَاضٍ عَنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي ذُبَابٍ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ مِينَاء َ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ أَنَّ
body: رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «لَا يَبُولَنَّ أَحَدُكُمْ فِي الْمَاءِ الدَّائِمِ ثُمَّ يَتَوَضَّأُ مِنْهُ أَوْ يَشْرَبُ»

title: ذِكْرُ خَبَرٍ أَوْهَمَ مَنْ لَمْ يَحْكُمْ صِنَاعَةَ الْحَدِيثِ أَنَّ اغْتِسَالَ الْجُنُبِ فِي الْمَاءِ الدَّائِمِ يُنَجِّسُهُ
chain_en: Abū Yaʿlá > Abū Khaythamah > Yaḥyá al-Qaṭṭān > Ibn ʿAjlān from his father > Abū Hurayrah
body_en: The Prophet ﷺ said: None amongst you should urinate in standing water, then wash in it after sexual defilement. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 70)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو يَعْلَى قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَيْثَمَةَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى الْقَطَّانُ عَنِ ابْنِ عَجْلَانَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ
body: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «لَا يَبُولُ أَحَدُكُمْ فِي الْمَاءِ الدَّائِمِ وَلَا يَغْتَسِلُ فِيهِ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ»

title: ذِكْرُ الْخَبَرِ الْمُدْحِضُ، قَوْلَ مَنْ زَعَمَ أَنَّ اغْتِسَالَ الْجُنُبِ فِي الْبِئْرِ يُنَجِّسُ مَا فِيهِ مِنَ الْمَاءِ
chain_en: ʿAbdullāh b. Muḥammad al-Azdī > Isḥāq b. Ibrāhīm > Jarīr > al-Shaybānī > Abū Burdah > Ḥudhayfah
body_en: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ met a man from among his Companions, he would shake hands with him and supplicate for him. I saw him one day in the early morning, and I tried to avoid him, then I came to him later in the day. He said: 'I saw you but you were avoiding me.' I said: 'I was Junub and I was afraid that you would touch me.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'The Muslim is not made impure (Najis).' (Using translation from Nasāʾī 267)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْأَزْدِيُّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ عَنِ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ قَالَ
body: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا لَقِيَ الرَّجُلَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ مَسَحَهُ وَدَعَا لَهُ قَالَ فَرَأَيْتُهُ يَوْمًا بُكْرَةً فَحِدْتُ عَنْهُ ثُمَّ أَتَيْتُهُ حِينَ ارْتَفَعَ النَّهَارُ فَقَالَ «إِنِّي رَأَيْتُكَ فَحِدْتَ عَنِّي» فَقُلْتُ إِنِّي كُنْتُ جُنُبًا فَخَشِيتُ أَنْ تَمَسَّنِي فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِنَّ الْمُسْلِمَ لَا يَنْجُسُ»

title: ذِكْرُ الْخَبَرِ الْمُدْحِضُ، قَوْلَ مَنْ زَعَمَ أَنَّ الْجُنُبَ إِذَا وَقَعَ فِي الْبِئْرِ وَهُوَ يَنْوِي الِاغْتِسَالَ يَنْجُسُ مَاءُ الْبِئْرِ
chain_en: Isḥāq b. Ibrāhīm b. Ismāʿīl Bibust > ʿAbd al-Wārith b. ʿUbaydullāh al-ʿAtakī > Marwān b. Muʿāwiyah al-Fazārī > Ḥumayd al-Ṭawīl > Bakr b. ʿAbdullāh > Abū Rāfiʿ > Abū Hurayrah
body_en: [Machine] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  met me while I was in a state of post-sex impurity. I walked with him while he held my hand, but I slipped away from him and left. Then, I performed ablution and returned to him, and sat with him. He asked, "Where were you, Abu Hurayrah?" I said, "You met me while I was in a state of post-sex impurity, so I disliked sitting with you." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Verily, a believer does not become impure."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بِبُسْتَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ بْنُ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ الْعَتَكِيُّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ الْفَزَارِيُّ عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ الطَّوِيلِ عَنْ بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ
body: لَقِيَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَأَنَا جُنُبٌ فَمَشَيْتُ مَعَهُ وَهُوَ آخِذٌ بِيَدِي فَانْسَلَلْتُ مِنْهُ فَانْطَلَقْتُ فَاغْتَسَلْتُ ثُمَّ رَجَعْتُ إِلَيْهِ فَجَلَسْتُ مَعَهُ فَقَالَ «أَيْنَ كُنْتَ يَا أَبَاهِرٍّ؟ » قُلْتُ لَقِيتَنِي وَأَنَا جُنُبٌ فَكَرِهْتُ أَنْ أُجَالِسَكَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِنَّ الْمُؤْمِنَ لَا يَنْجُسُ»

h2_title_en: [Machine] The virtue of a woman's ablution.
title: null
chain_en: ʿAlī b. Aḥmad b. Bisṭām Bi-al-Baṣrah > ʿAmr b. ʿAlī b. Baḥr > Abū Dāwud > Shuʿbah > ʿĀṣim al-Aḥwal > Abū Ḥājib > al-Ḥakam b. ʿAmr al-Ghifārī
body_en: The Messenger of Allah forbade men to perform ablution with the left over water by a woman. (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 373)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ بِسْطَامٍ بِالْبَصْرَةِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ بَحْرٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةَ عَنْ عَاصِمٍ الْأَحْوَلِ قال سَمِعْتُ أَبَا حَاجِبٍ يُحَدِّثُ عَنِ الْحَكَمِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو الْغِفَارِيِّ
body: «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ نَهَى أَنْ يَتَوَضَّأَ الرَّجُلُ بِفَضْلِ وُضُوءِ الْمَرْأَةِ»

h2_title_en: [Machine] The virtue of a woman's ablution.
title: ذِكْرُ خَبَرٍ يُصَرِّحُ بِاسْتِعْمَالِ الْمُصْطَفَى ﷺ هَذَا الْفِعْلَ الْمَزْجُورَ عَنْهُ
chain_en: ʿAbdullāh b. Muḥammad b. al-Junayd > Qutaybah b. Saʿīd > Abū al-Aḥwaṣ > Simāk > ʿIkrimah > Ibn ʿAbbās
body_en: One of the wives of the Prophet performed Ghusl with a bowl. Messenger of Allah wanted to perform Wudu with it, so she said: 'O Messenger of Allah! Indeed I am ]unub.' So he said: 'Indeed, water does not become Junub.' (Using translation from Tirmidhī 65)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْجُنَيْدِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْأَحْوَصِ عَنْ سِمَاكٍ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ
body: اغْتَسَلَ بَعْضُ أَزْوَاجِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فِي جَفْنَةٍ فَأَرَادَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنْ يَتَوَضَّأَ مِنْهُ فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي كُنْتُ جُنُبًا فَقَالَ «الْمَاءُ لَا يُجْنِبُ»

h2_title_en: [Machine] The virtue of a woman's ablution.
title: ذِكْرُ خَبَرٍ ثَانٍ يُصَرِّحُ بِإِبَاحَةِ هَذَا الْفِعْلِ الْمَزْجُورِ عَنْهُ
chain_en: ʿUmar b. Muḥammad al-Hamdānī > Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Aʿlá > Khālid b. al-Ḥārith > Shuʿbah > ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. al-Qāsim > al-Qāsim > ʿĀʾishah
body_en: I heard Al-Qasim narrating that 'Aishah said: 'I used to perform Ghusl, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and I from a single vessel, from Janabah.' (Using translation from Nasāʾī 233)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْهَمْدَانِيُّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْأَعْلَى قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْقَاسِمَ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ
body: «كُنْتُ أَغْتَسِلُ أَنَا وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ مِنْ إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ»

title: ذِكْرُ تَرْكِ إِنْكَارِ الْمُصْطَفَى ﷺ عَلَى مَنْ فَعَلَ هَذَا الْفِعْلَ الْمَزْجُورَ عَنْهُ فِي خَبَرِ الْحَكَمِ ابْنِ عَمْرٍو
chain_en: al-Ḥasan b. Sufyān > ʿĀṣim b. al-Naḍr > Muʿtamir b. Sulaymān > ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿUmar > Nāfiʿ > Ibn ʿUmar
body_en: [Machine] "He (Prophet Muhammad peace be upon him) saw himself and his companions purifying themselves. Both men and women purify themselves from the same vessel. They all purify themselves with it."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ سُفْيَانَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمُ بْنُ النَّضْرِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ
body: «أَنَّهُ أَبْصَرَ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ وَأَصْحَابَهُ يَتَطَهَّرُونَ الرِّجَالُ وَالنِّسَاءُ مِنْ إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ كُلُّهُمْ يَتَطَهَّرُ مِنْهُ»

title: ذِكْرُ الْخَبَرِ الْمُدْحِضُ، قَوْلَ مَنْ نَفَى جَوَازَ الْوُضُوءِ بِفَضْلِ مَا بَقِيَ مِنَ الْمُغْتَسِلِ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ

body_en: I heard Al-Qasim narrating that 'Aishah said: 'I used to perform Ghusl, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and I from a single vessel, from Janabah.' (Using translation from Nasāʾī 233)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا الْفَضْلُ بْنُ الْحُبَابِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ
body: «كُنْتُ أَغْتَسِلُ أَنَا وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ مِنْ إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ»

h2_title_en: [Machine] The virtue of a woman's ablution.
title: ذِكْرُ الْإِبَاحَةِ لِلرِّجَالِ وَالنِّسَاءِ أَنْ يَتَوَضَّؤُوا مِنْ إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ
chain_en: Abū Khalīfah > al-Qaʿnabī > Mālik > Nāfiʿ
body_en: [Machine] Narrated by Al-Qa'nabi from Malik from Nafi' that Ibn 'Umar used to say, "Verily, men and women used to perform ablution during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ altogether."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو خَلِيفَةَ قَالَ
body: حَدَّثَنَا الْقَعْنَبِيُّ عَنْ مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ كَانَ يَقُولُ «إِنَّ الرِّجَالَ وَالنِّسَاءَ كَانُوا يَتَوَضَّؤونَ فِي زَمَنِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ جَمِيعًا»

title: ذِكْرُ الْخَبَرِ الدَّالِّ عَلَى أَنَّ الْمَاءَ الْمُسْتَعْمَلَ الْمُؤَدَّى بِهِ الْفَرْضُ مَرَّةً طَاهِرٌ جَائِزٌ أَنْ يُؤَدَّى بِهِ الْفَرْضُ أُخْرَى
chain_en: Abū Khalīfah > Abū al-Walīd > Shuʿbah > Muḥammad b. al-Munkadir > Jābir b. ʿAbdullāh
body_en: [Machine] Jabir ibn Abdullah narrated: "The Prophet ﷺ  came to visit me while I was sick and unaware of my surroundings. He performed ablution (wudu) and poured the water from his wudu onto me." I regained my consciousness and asked, "O Messenger of Allah, who will inherit from me?" The only relatives I have are my maternal uncles, and then the verse of inheritance was revealed."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو خَلِيفَةَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ
body: عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ يَقُولُ «جَاءَنِي النَّبِيُّ ﷺ يَعُودُنِي وَأَنَا مَرِيضٌ لَا أَعْقِلُ فَتَوَضَّأَ وَصَبَّ مِنْ وَضُوئِهِ عَلَيَّ» فَعَقَلْتُ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ لِمَنِ الْمِيرَاثُ؟ فَإِنَّمَا يَرِثُنِي كَلَالَةً فَنَزَلَتْ آيَةُ الْفَرَائِضِ

title: ذِكْرُ خَبَرٍ يَنْفِي الرِّيَبَ عَنِ الْخُلَدِ، بِالتَّصْرِيحِ بِإِبَاحَةِ مَا ذَكَرْنَاهُ
chain_en: Abū Yaʿlá > ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿUmar al-Qawārīrī > Yazīd b. Zurayʿ > Shuʿbah > al-Ḥakam > Dhar > Ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Abzá from his father
body_en: [Machine] Ammar, do you remember when you and I were in a secret meeting during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ? It was mentioned to him, and he said ﷺ: "It was enough for you." Then he struck the ground with his hand, blew into his palms, wiped his face, and passed his hands over his head.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو يَعْلَى قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ الْقَوَارِيرِيُّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ ذَرٍّ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبْزَى عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ سَأَلَ رَجُلٌ عُمَرَ فَقَالَ إِنِّي أَجْنَبْتُ فَلَمْ أَجِدِ الْمَاءَ فَقَالَ لَا تُصَلِّ فَقَالَ
body: عَمَّارٌ أَمَا تَذْكُرُ إِذْ كُنْتُ أَنَا وَأَنْتَ فِي سَرِيَّةٍ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَذُكِرَ ذَلِكَ لَهُ فَقَالَ ﷺ «إِنَّمَا كَانَ يَكْفِيكَ وَضَرَبَ بِيَدِهِ الْأَرْضَ ضَرْبَةً فَنَفَخَ فِي كَفَّيْهِ وَمَسَحَ وَجْهَهُ وَكَفَّيْهِ»

title: ذِكْرُ إِبَاحَةِ التَّبَرُّكِ بِوَضُوءٍ الصَّالِحِينَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْعِلْمِ إِذَا كَانُوا مُتَّبِعِينَ لَسُنَنِ الْمُصْطَفَى ﷺ دُونَ أَهْلِ الْبِدَعِ مِنْهُمْ
chain_en: ʿAbdullāh b. Muḥammad al-Azdī > Isḥāq b. Ibrāhīm > Abū ʿĀmir al-ʿAqadī > ʿUmar b. Abū Zāʾidah > ʿAwn b. Abū Juḥayfah from his father
body_en: [Machine] "I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  in a red dome, and I saw Bilal calling the Adhan. I noticed that people were rushing towards his light and wiping themselves with it. Then Bilal brought a goat, milked it, and offered the milk to the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ . The Prophet ﷺ  then came out dressed in a red cloak, performed the prayer, and people and animals were passing in front of him."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْأَزْدِيُّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَامِرٍ الْعَقَدِيُّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ عَنْ عَوْنِ بْنِ أَبِي جُحَيْفَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ
body: «رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي قُبَّةٍ حَمْرَاءَ وَرَأَيْتُ بِلَالًا أَخْرَجَ وَضُوءَهُ فَرَأَيْتُ النَّاسَ يَبْتَدِرُونَ وَضُوءَهُ يَتَمَسَّحُونَ قَالَ ثُمَّ أَخْرَجَ بِلَالٌ عَنْزَةً فَرَكَزَهَا ثُمَّ خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي حُلَّةٍ حَمْرَاءَ سِيَرَاءَ فَصَلَّى إِلَيْهَا وَالنَّاسُ وَالدَّوَابُّ يَمُرُّونَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ»

title: ذِكْرُ إِبَاحَةِ اغْتِسَالِ الْجُنُبِ مِنَ الْأَوَانِي الَّتِي اتُّخِذَتْ مِنْ خَشَبٍ
chain_en: Muḥammad b. ʿAbdullāh b. al-Junayd > Qutaybah b. Saʿīd > Abū al-Aḥwaṣ > Simāk > ʿIkrimah > Ibn ʿAbbās
body_en: One of the wives of the Prophet ﷺ took a bath from a large bowl. The Prophet ﷺ wanted to perform ablution or take from the water left over. She said to him: O Prophet of Allah, verily I was sexually defiled. The Prophet said: Water not defiled. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 68)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْجُنَيْدِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْأَحْوَصِ عَنْ سِمَاكٍ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ
body: اغْتَسَلَ بَعْضُ أَزْوَاجِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فِي جَفْنَةٍ فَجَاءَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ يَتَوَضَّأُ أَوْ يَغْتَسِلُ مِنْ فَضْلِهَا فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي كُنْتُ جُنُبًا فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِنَّ الْمَاءَ لَا يُنَجِّسُهُ شَيْءٌ»

title: ذِكْرُ الْأَمْرِ بِتَخْمِيرِ الْإِنَاءِ بِاللَّيْلِ وَلَوْ بِعُودٍ يُعْرَضُ عَلَيْهِ
chain_en: Muḥammad b. al-Mundhir b. Saʿīd > Yūsuf b. Saʿīd > Ḥajjāj > Ibn Jurayj > Abū al-Zubayr > Jābir > Abū Ḥumayd al-Sāʿidī
body_en: [Machine] "I (have) brought the Messenger of Allah ﷺ milk, and he (was) in need of food (i.e. not having any food yet), not fermented. So he said, 'Shouldn't you ferment it, even if you let a stick touch it?'"
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجٌ عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ جَابِرٍ عَنْ أَبِي حُمَيْدٍ السَّاعِدِيِّ قَالَ
body: أَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِلَبَنٍ وَهُوَ بِالنَّقِيعِ غَيْرِ مُخَمَّرٍ فَقَالَ «أَلَا خَمَّرْتَهُ وَلَوْ تَعْرِضُ عَلَيْهِ عُودًا»

title: ذِكْرُ الْأَمْرِ بِإِغْلَاقِ الْأَبْوَابِ وَإِيكَاءِ السِّقَاءِ وَإِطْفَاءِ الْمِصْبَاحِ وَتَخْمِيرِ الْإِنَاءِ
chain_en: Abū Bakr ʿUmar b. Saʿīd b. Sinān > Aḥmad b. Abū Bakr > Mālik > Abū al-Zubayr al-Makkī > Jābir b. ʿAbdullāh
body_en: [Machine] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Close the doors, cover the containers, put out the lamps, for indeed, Shaytan does not open a closed door, nor untie a tied knot, nor uncover a container. And verily, the sinful person sets fire to people's homes."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ عُمَرُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ عَنْ مَالِكٍ عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ الْمَكِّيِّ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ
body: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «أَغْلِقُوا الْأَبْوَابَ وَأَوْكُوا السِّقَاءَ وَخَمِّرُوا الْإِنَاءَ وَأَطْفِئُوا الْمِصْبَاحَ فَإِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ لَا يَفْتَحُ غَلَقًا وَلَا يَحُلُّ وِكَاءً وَلَا يَكْشِفُ إِنَاءً وَإِنَّ الْفُوَيْسِقَةَ تُضْرِمُ عَلَى النَّاسِ بَيْتَهُمْ»

title: ذِكْرُ الْبَيَانِ بِأَنَّ الْأَمْرَ بِهَذِهِ الْأَشْيَاءِ إِنَّمَا أَمْرٌ مَعَ التَّسْمِيَةِ
chain_en: ʿUmar b. Muḥammad al-Hamdānī > ʿAmr b. ʿAlī > Yaḥyá al-Qaṭṭān > Ibn Jurayj > ʿAṭāʾ > Jābir b. ʿAbdullāh
body_en: Shut your door and make mention of Allah's name, for the devil does not open a door which has been shut; extinguish your lamp and make mention of Allah's name, cover up your vessel even by a piece of wood that you just put on it and make mention of Allah's name, and tie up your water-skin mentioning Allah's name. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3731)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْهَمْدَانِيُّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَلِيٍّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى الْقَطَّانُ عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَطَاءٌ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ
body: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «أَغْلِقْ بَابَكَ وَاذْكُرِ اسْمَ اللَّهِ فَإِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ لَا يَفْتَحُ بَابًا مُغْلَقًا وَأَطْفِئْ مِصْبَاحَكَ وَاذْكُرِ اسْمَ اللَّهِ وَأَوْكِ سِقَاءَكَ وَاذْكُرِ اسْمَ اللَّهِ وَخَمِّرْ إِنَاءَكَ وَاذْكُرِ اسْمَ اللَّهِ وَلَوْ بِعُودٍ يُعْرَضُ عَلَيْهِ»

title: ذِكْرُ الْبَيَانِ بِأَنَّ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ بِهَذِهِ الْأَشْيَاءِ إِنَّمَا أَمْرٌ بِاسْتِعْمَالِهَا لَيْلًا لَا نَهَارًا
chain_en: ʿAbdullāh b. Aḥmad b. Mūsá ʿAbdān > Muḥammad b. Maʿmar > Abū ʿĀṣim > Ibn Jurayj > Abū al-Zubayr > Jābir
body_en: [Machine] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  commanded us with four things and prohibited us from five things: When you go to sleep, close your door, cover your water container, cover your utensils, and extinguish your lamp. For surely, Satan does not open a door, nor untie a shoelace, nor uncover a vessel. And indeed, a rebellious rat can set a house on fire. Do not eat or drink with your left hand, do not walk with one shoe, do not cover your mouth and nose while yawning, and do not drag your garment trailing behind you."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُوسَى عَبْدَانُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مَعْمَرٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ جَابِرٍ قَالَ
body: «أَمَرَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِأَرْبَعٍ وَنَهَانَا عَنْ خَمْسٍ إِذَا رَقَدْتَ فَأَغْلِقْ بَابَكَ وَأَوْكِ سِقَاءَكَ وَخَمِّرْ إِنَاءَكَ وَأَطْفِئْ مِصْبَاحَكَ فَإِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ لَا يَفْتَحُ بَابًا وَلَا يَحُلُّ وِكَاءً وَلَا يَكْشِفُ غِطَاءً وَإِنَّ الْفَأْرَةَ الْفُوَيْسِقَةَ تُحْرِقُ عَلَى أَهْلِ الْبَيْتِ بَيْتَهُمْ وَلَا تَأْكُلْ بِشِمَالِكَ وَلَا تَشْرَبْ بِشِمَالِكَ وَلَا تَمْشِ فِي نَعْلٍ وَاحِدَةٍ وَلَا تَشْتَمِلِ الصَّمَّاءَ وَلَا تَحْتَبِ فِي الإزار * مُفْضِيًا»

title: ذِكْرُ الْخَبَرِ الْمَصَرِّحِ بِأَنَّ الْأَمْرَ بِهَذِهِ الْأَشْيَاءِ أَمْرٌ بِاسْتِعْمَالِهَا بِاللَّيْلِ دُونَ النَّهَارِ
chain_en: al-Ḥasan b. Sufyān > al-Ḥasan b. al-Ṣabbāḥ al-Bazzār > Ismāʿīl b. ʿAbd al-Karīm > Ibrāhīm b. ʿAqīl b. Maʿqil from his father > Wahbb. Munabbih > Jābir b. ʿAbdullāh
body_en: [Machine] The Prophet ﷺ  used to say, "Cover your water containers, close your doors when you sleep at night, cover your food and drinks, for the devil enters if he finds an open door and drinks if he finds an uncovered vessel. If he finds a closed door and a covered vessel, he will not be able to enter or drink. If any of you cannot find something to cover his drink with, he should place a stick on it."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ سُفْيَانَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ الْبَزَّارُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ عَقِيلِ بْنِ مَعْقِلٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ وَهْبِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي جَابِرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ
body: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ يَقُولُ «أَوْكُوا الْأَسْقِيَةَ وَغَلِّقُوا الْأَبْوَابَ إِذَا رَقَدْتُمْ بِاللَّيْلِ وَخَمِّرُوا الطَّعَامَ وَالشَّرَابَ فَإِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ يَأْتِي فَإِنْ لَمْ يَجِدِ الْبَابَ مُغْلَقًا دَخَلَ وَإِنْ لَمْ يَجِدِ السِّقَاءَ مُوكًى شَرِبَ مِنْهُ وَإِنْ وَجَدَ الْبَابَ مُغْلَقًا وَالسِّقَاءَ مُوكًى لَمْ يَحْلِلْ وِكَاءً وَلَمْ يَفْتَحْ بَابًا مُغْلَقًا وَإِنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ أَحَدُكُمْ لِإِنَائِهِ الَّذِي فِيهِ شَرَابُهُ مَا يُخَمِّرُهُ فَلْيَعْرِضْ عَلَيْهِ عُودًا»

grade_grade_en: Good Due to External Factors, Parts of It
grade_grades: Arnaʾūṭ:Good Due to External Factors, Parts of It
title: ذِكْرُ الْبَيَانِ بِأَنَّ الْأَمْرَ بِهَذِهِ الْأَشْيَاءِ الَّتِي وَصَفْنَاهَا أَمْرٌ بِاسْتِعْمَالِهَا فِي بَعْضِ اللَّيْلِ لَا كُلِّهِ
chain_en: Muḥammad b. Isḥāq b. Khuzaymah > Yūsuf b. Mūsá > Jarīr > Fiṭr b. Khalīfah > Abū al-Zubayr > Jābir
body_en: [Machine] We have the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "Close your doors, extinguish your lamps, cover your utensils, and block all openings, for surely the devil does not open a closed door, nor untie a tied knot, nor uncover a covered vessel. And indeed, the evildoer may set his house on fire with his family inside. So, extinguish your lamps and protect your families until the darkness of the night has disappeared."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ خُزَيْمَةَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ بْنُ مُوسَى قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ عَنْ فِطْرِ بْنِ خَلِيفَةَ عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ جَابِرٍ قَالَ قَالَ
body: لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «غَلَّقُوا أَبْوَابَكُمْ وَأَوْكُوا أَسْقِيَتَكُمْ وَخَمِّرُوا آنِيَتَكُمْ وَأَطْفِئُوا سُرُجَكُمْ فَإِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ لَا يَفْتَحُ غَلَقًا وَلَا يَحُلُّ وِكَاءً وَلَا يَكْشِفُ غِطَاءً وَإِنَّ الْفُوَيْسِقَةَ رُبَّمَا أَضْرَمَتْ عَلَى أَهْلِ الْبَيْتِ بَيْتَهُمْ وَكُفُّوا فَوَاشِيَكُمْ* وَأَهْلِيكُمْ عِنْدَ غُرُوبِ الشَّمْسِ إِلَى أَنْ تَذْهَبَ فَجْوَةُ الْعِشَاءِ»

title: ذِكْرُ الْعِلَّةِ الَّتِي مِنْ أَجْلِهَا أُمِرَ بِهَذَا الْأَمْرِ فِي هَذَا الْوَقْتِ
chain_en: Aḥmad b. ʿAlī b. al-Muthanná > Ibrāhīm b. al-Ḥajjāj > Ḥammād b. Salamah > Ḥabīb al-Muʿallim > ʿAṭāʾ b. Abū Rabāḥ > Jābir b. ʿAbdullāh
body_en: [Machine] The Messenger of Allah (PBUH) said, "Restrain your voices until the fear of dinner is gone, as it is an hour in which the devil spreads mischief."

chain_en: Muḥammad b. ʿAbdullāh b. al-Junayd > Qutaybah b. Saʿīd > Abū al-Aḥwaṣ > Simāk > ʿIkrimah > Ibn ʿAbbās
body_en: [Machine] A sheep died for the Prophet's wife. The Prophet came to her and she informed him about it. He said, "Did you not benefit from its skin?" She asked, "O Messenger of Allah, can one benefit from the skin of a dead animal?" The Messenger of Allah recited to her, "{Say, 'I do not find within that which was revealed to me [anything] forbidden to one who would eat it unless it be a dead animal} until the end of the verse. Indeed, you are not consuming it." Ibn Abbas said, "So she was sent to and she was skinned, and she made use of its skin."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْجُنَيْدِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْأَحْوَصِ عَنْ سِمَاكٍ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ
body: مَاتَتْ شَاةٌ لَزَوْجَةِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَأَتَاهَا النَّبِيُّ ﷺ فَأَخْبَرَتْهُ فَقَالَ «أَلَا انْتَفَعْتُمْ بِمَسْكِهَا»؟ فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَسْكُ مَيْتَةٍ؟ قَالَ فَقَرَأَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ {قُلْ لَا أَجِدُ فِيمَا أُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ مُحَرَّمًا عَلَى طَاعِمٍ يَطْعَمُهُ إِلَّا أَنْ يَكُونَ مَيْتَةً} إِلَى آخِرِ الْآيَةِ إِنَّكُمْ لَسْتُمْ تَأْكُلُونَهُ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ «فَبَعَثَتْ إِلَيْهَا فَسُلِخَتْ فَجَعَلَتْ مِنْ مَسْكِهَا قِرْبَةً»

title: ذِكْرُ الْبَيَانِ بِأَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ إِنَّمَا أَبَاحَ لَهَا فِي الِانْتِفَاعِ بِجَلْدِ الْمَيْتَةِ الَّذِي ذَكَرْنَاهُ
chain_en: Abū Yaʿlá > Muḥammad b. Abū Bakr al-Muqaddamī > Abū ʿAwānah > Simāk b. Ḥarb > ʿIkrimah > Ibn ʿAbbās > Mātat Shāh Lisawdah b. Zamʿah
body_en: [Machine] "O Messenger of Allah, Fulanah, meaning the sheep, has died." He said, "Why didn't you take its hide?" She said, "So we took the hide of a sheep that died." The Prophet ﷺ  said, "He only said, '{Say, 'I do not find within that which was revealed to me [anything] forbidden to one who would eat it, unless it be a dead animal or blood spilled out or the flesh of swine - for indeed, it is impure - or it be [that slaughtered in] disobedience, dedicated to other than Allah. But whoever is forced [by necessity], neither desiring [it] nor transgressing [its limit], there is no sin upon him. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.']' until the end of the verse. There is no harm in dyeing it so that you may benefit from it." He said, "So we sent it to her and she tanned its hide until it got burnt."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو يَعْلَى قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الْمُقَدَّمِيُّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ مَاتَتْ شَاةٌ لِسَوْدَةَ بِنْتِ زَمْعَةَ فَقَالَتْ
body: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَاتَتْ فُلَانَةٌ يَعْنِي الشَّاةَ قَالَ «فَهَلَّا أَخَذْتُمْ مَسْكَهَا؟ » قَالَتْ فَنَأْخُذُ مَسْكَ شَاةٍ مَاتَتْ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ «إِنَّمَا قَالَ {قُلْ لَا أَجِدُ فِيمَا أُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ مُحَرَّمًا} إِلَى آخِرِ الْآيَةِ لَا بَأْسَ أَنْ تَدْبُغُوهُ فَتَنْتَفِعُوا بِهِ» قَالَ «فَأَرْسَلْنَا إِلَيْهَا فَسَلَخَتْ مَسْكَهَا فَاتَّخَذَتْ مِنْهَا قِرْبَةً حَتَّى تَحَرَّقَتْ»

body_en: The Prophet ﷺ saw a dead sheep which had been given in charity to a freed slave-girl of Maimuna, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ . The Prophet ﷺ said, "Why don't you get the benefit of its hide?" They said, "It is dead." He replied, "Only to eat (its meat) is illegal." (Using translation from Bukhārī 1492)

body: مَرَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِشَاةٍ مِنَ الصَّدَقَةِ مَيْتَةٍ أُعْطِيَتْهَا مَوْلَاةٌ لِمَيْمُونَةَ فَقَالَ «أَلَا أَخَذُوا إِهَابَهَا فَدَبَغُوهَا فَانْتَفَعُوا بِهَا؟ » فَقَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّهَا مَيْتَةٌ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ «إِنَّمَا حُرِّمَ أَكْلُهَا»

chain_en: ʿAbdullāh b. Muḥammad b. Salm > Ḥarmalah > Ibn Wahb > ʿAmr b. al-Ḥārith > Kathīr b. Farqad > ʿAbdullāh b. Mālik b. Ḥudhāfah > Ummih al-ʿĀliyah b. Subayʿ
body_en: I had some sheep at Uhud, and they began to die. I then entered upon Maymunah, wife of the Prophet ﷺ, and mentioned it to her. Maymunah said to me: If you took their skins and made use of them, (that would be better for you). She asked: Is that lawful? She replied, Yes. Some people of the Quraysh passed by the Messenger of Allah ﷺ dragging a sheep of theirs as big as an ass. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to them: Would that you took its skin. They said: It died a natural death. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Water and leaves of the mimosa flava purify it. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 4126)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَلْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَرْمَلَةُ عَنِ ابْنِ وَهْبٍ أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ كَثِيرِ بْنِ فَرْقَدٍ أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ مَالِكِ بْنِ حُذَافَةَ حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ أُمِّهِ الْعَالِيَةِ بِنْتِ سُبَيْعٍ
body: أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ كَانَ لِي غَنْمٌ بِأُحُدٍ فَوَقَعَ فِيهَا الْمَوْتُ فَدَخَلْتُ عَلَى مَيْمُونَةَ فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لَهَا فَقَالَتْ لِي مَيْمُونَةُ لَوْ أَخَذْتِ جُلُودَهَا فَانْتَفَعْتِ بِهَا؟ قَالَتْ فَقُلْتُ وَيَحِلُّ ذَلِكَ؟ قَالَتْ نَعَمْ مَرَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَلَى رِجَالٍ مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ يَجُرُّونَ شَاةً لَهُمْ مِثْلَ الْحِمَارِ فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَوْ أَخَذْتُمْ إِهَابَهَا» قَالُوا إِنَّهَا مَيْتَةٌ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «يُطَهِّرُهَا الْمَاءُ وَالْقَرَظُ»

title: ذِكْرُ إِبَاحَةِ مَجِّ الْمَرْءِ فِي الْبِئْرِ الَّتِي يُسْتَقَى مِنْهَا

body_en: [Machine] "He used a bucket to draw water from a well in his house."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ قُتَيْبَةَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي السَّرِيِّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ مَحْمُودِ بْنِ الرَّبِيعِ
body: «أَنَّهُ عَقَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَعَقَلَ مَجَّةً مَجَّهَا مِنْ دَلْوٍ فِي بِئْرٍ فِي دَارِهِمْ»

title: ذِكْرُ الْخَبَرِ الْمُدْحِضِ قَوْلَ مَنْ زَعَمَ أَنَّ سُؤْرَ الْمَرْأَةِ الْحَائِضِ نَجِسٌ
chain_en: ʿImrān b. Mūsá b. Mujāshiʿ > ʿUthmān b. Abū Shaybah > Wakīʿ > Misʿar And Sufyān > al-Miqdām b. Shurayḥ from his father > ʿĀʾishah
body_en: [Machine] "I used to place the vessel on my lap while I was menstruating, and then I would offer it to the Prophet ﷺ so he could place his mouth on the exact spot where I placed mine and he would take a sip while I was menstruating, and then I would offer it to him again and he would place his mouth on the exact spot."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عِمْرَانُ بْنُ مُوسَى بْنِ مُجَاشِعٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ عَنْ مِسْعَرٍ وَسُفْيَانَ عَنِ الْمِقْدَامِ بْنِ شُرَيْحٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ
body: «كُنْتُ أَضَعُ الْإِنَاءَ عَلَى فِي وَأَنَا حَائِضٌ ثُمَّ أُنَاوِلُهُ لِلنَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَيَضَعُ فَاهُ عَلَى مَوْضِعِ فِيَّ وَآخُذُ الْعَرْقَ وَأَنَا حَائِضٌ ثُمَّ أُنَاوِلُهُ فَيَضَعُ فَاهُ عَلَى مَوْضِعِ فِيَّ»

title: ذِكْرُ الْأَمْرِ بِغَسْلِ الْإِنَاءِ مِنْ وُلُوغِ الْكَلْبِ بِعَدَدٍ مَعْلُومٍ
chain_en: ʿAbdullāh b. Aḥmad b. Mūsá Biʿaskar Mukram > ʿUqbah b. Mukram al-ʿAmmī > Yūnus b. Bukayr > Hishām b. ʿUrwah > Abū al-Zinād > al-Aʿraj > Abū Hurayrah
body_en: The Messenger of Allah said: "If a dog licks the vessel of anyome of you, let him wash it seven times." (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 364)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُوسَى بِعَسْكَرِ مُكْرَمٍ حَدَّثَنَا عُقْبَةُ بْنُ مُكْرَمٍ الْعَمِّيُّ حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ عَنِ الْأَعْرَجِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ
body: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «إِذَا وَلَغَ الْكَلْبُ فِي إِنَاءِ أَحَدِكُمْ فَاغْسِلُوهُ سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ»

title: ذِكْرُ الْخَبَرِ الدَّالِّ عَلَى أَنَّ نَجَاسَةَ مَا فِي الْإِنَاءِ بَعْدَ وُلُوغِ الْكَلْبِ فِيهِ
chain_en: Ibn Qutaybah > Ibn Abū al-Sarī > ʿAbd al-Razzāq > Maʿmar > Hammām b. Munabbih > Abū Hurayrah
body_en: [Machine] The Messenger of Allahﷺ said: "The purification of the vessel for one of you, if a dog has licked in it, is to wash it seven times."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ قُتَيْبَةَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي السَّرِيِّ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ
body: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «طَهُورُ إِنَاءِ أَحَدِكُمْ إِذَا وَلَغَ فِيهِ الْكَلْبُ أَنْ يُغْسَلَ سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ»

title: ذِكْرُ الْخَبَرِ الْمُدْحِضِ قَوْلَ مَنْ زَعَمَ أَنَّ مَا فِي الْإِنَاءِ بَعْدَ وُلُوغِ الْكَلْبِ فِيهِ طَاهِرٌ غَيْرُ نَجِسٍ يُنْتَفَعُ بِهِ

body_en: The Messenger of Allah said: 'If a dog licks the vessel of anyone of you, let him wash it seven times.' (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 366)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ خُزَيْمَةَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى الذُّهْلِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ خَلِيلٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ وَأَبِي رَزِينٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ
body: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِذَا وَلَغَ الْكَلْبُ فِي إِنَاءِ أَحَدِكُمْ فَلْيُهْرِقْهُ ثُمَّ لِيَغْسِلْهُ سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ»

title: ذِكْرُ الْبَيَانِ بِأَنَّ الْمَرْءَ مَأْمُورٌ عِنْدَ غَسْلِهِ الْإِنَاءَ مِنْ وُلُوغِ الْكَلْبِ فِيهِ أَنْ يَجْعَلَ أَوَّلَ الْغَسَلَاتِ بِالتُّرَابِ
chain_en: Aḥmad b. ʿAlī b. al-Muthanná > Abū Khaythamah > Ismāʿīl b. Ibrāhīm > Hishām b. Ḥassān > Muḥammad b. Sīrīn > Abū Hurayrah
body_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: The purification of the utensil belonging to any one of you, after it is licked by a dog, lies in washing it seven times, using sand for the first time. (Using translation from Muslim 279d)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْمُثَنَّى حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَيْثَمَةَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ حَسَّانَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ
body: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «طَهُورُ إِنَاءِ أَحَدِكُمْ إِذَا وَلَغَ فِيهِ الْكَلْبُ أَنْ يَغْسِلَهُ سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ أُولَاهُنَّ بِالتُّرَابِ»

title: ذِكْرُ الْبَيَانِ بِأَنَّ الْمَرْءَ يُسْتَحَبُّ لَهُ عِنْدَ غَسْلِهِ الْإِنَاءَ مِنْ وُلُوغِ الْكَلْبِ أَنْ يُعَفِّرَ الْإِنَاءَ بِالتُّرَابِ عِنْدَ الثَّامِنَةِ
chain_en: ʿUmar b. Muḥammad al-Hamdānī > Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Aʿlá > Khālid b. al-Ḥārith > Shuʿbah > Abū al-Tayyāḥ > Muṭarrif b. ʿAbdullāh b. al-Shikhhīr > ʿAbdullāh b. Mughaffal
body_en: The Messenger of Allah said: 'If a dog licks a vessel, wash it seven times and rub it with dust the eight times." (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 365)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْهَمْدَانِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْأَعْلَى حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنْ أَبِي التَّيَّاحِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُطَرِّفَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الشِّخِّيرِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُغَفَّلٍ
body: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «إِذَا وَلَغَ الْكَلْبُ فِي الْإِنَاءِ فَاغْسِلُوهُ سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ وَعَفِّرُوا الثَّامِنَةَ بِالتُّرَابِ»

title: ذِكْرُ الْخَبَرِ الدَّالِّ عَلَى أَنَّ أَسْآرَ السِّبَاعِ كُلَّهَا طَاهِرَةٌ
chain_en: al-Faḍl b. al-Ḥubāb > al-Qaʿnabī > Mālik > Isḥāq b. ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Ṭalḥah > Ḥumaydah b. ʿUbayd b. Rifāʿah > Kabshah b. Kaʿb b. Mālik And Kānat Taḥt Abū Qatādah
body_en: Kabshah, daughter of Ka'b ibn Malik and wife of Ibn AbuQatadah, reported: AbuQatadah visited (me) and I poured out water for him for ablution. A cat came and drank some of it and he tilted the vessel for it until it drank some of it. Kabshah said: He saw me looking at him; he asked me: Are you surprised, my niece? I said: Yes. He then reported the Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying: It is not unclean; it is one of those (males or females) who go round among you. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 75)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا الْفَضْلُ بْنُ الْحُبَابِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا الْقَعْنَبِيُّ عَنْ مَالِكٍ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ عَنْ حُمَيْدَةَ بِنْتِ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ رِفَاعَةَ عَنْ كَبْشَةَ بِنْتِ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ
body: وَكَانَتْ تَحْتَ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ أَنَّ أَبَا قَتَادَةَ دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا فَسَكَبَتْ لَهُ وُضُوءًا فَجَاءَتْ هِرَّةٌ تَشْرَبُ فَأَصْغَى أَبُو قَتَادَةَ الْإِنَاءَ فَشَرِبَتْ قَالَتْ كَبْشَةُ فَرَآنِي أَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِ فَقَالَ أَتَعْجَبِينَ يَا ابْنَةَ أَخِي؟ فَقُلْتُ نَعَمْ فَقَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «إِنَّهَا لَيْسَتْ بِنَجَسٍ إِنَّمَا هِيَ مِنَ الطَّوَّافِينَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَالطَّوَّافَاتِ»

title: null
chain_en: al-Faḍl b. al-Ḥubāb > al-Qaʿnabī > Mālik > ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. al-Qāsim from his father > ʿĀʾishah
body_en: We went out with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on one of his journeys, and when we were in Al-Baida' or Dhat Al-Jaish, a necklace of mine broke and fell. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ stayed there looking for it and the people stayed with him. There was no water near them, and they did not have water with them. The people came to Abu Bakr, may Allah be pleased with him, and said: 'Do you see what 'Aishah has done? She has made the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and the people stop and they are not near any water and they do not have water with them.' Abu Bakr, may Allah be pleased with him, came while the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was resting his head on my thigh and had gone to sleep. He said: 'You have detained the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and the people, and they are not near any water and they do not have any water with them.' 'Aishah said: "Abu Bakr rebuked me and said whatever Allah willed he would say. He started poking me on my hip, and the only thing that prevented me from moving was the fact that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was resting on my thigh. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ slept until morning when he woke up without any water. Then Allah, the Mighty and Sublime revealed the verse of Tayammum. Usaid bin Hudair said: 'This is not the first time we have been blessed because of you, O family of Abu Bakr!'" She said: "Then we made the camel that I had been riding stand up, and we found the necklace beneath it." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 310)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا الْفَضْلُ بْنُ الْحُبَابِ قَالَ
body: حَدَّثَنَا الْقَعْنَبِيُّ عَنْ مَالِكٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ «خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي بَعْضِ أَسْفَارِهِ حَتَّى إِذَا كُنَّا بِالْبَيْدَاءِ أَوْ بِذَاتِ الْجَيْشِ انْقَطَعَ عِقْدٌ لِي فَأَقَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَلَى الْتِمَاسِهِ فَأَقَامَ مَعَهُ النَّاسُ وَلَيْسُوا عَلَى مَاءٍ وَلَيْسَ مَعَهُمْ مَاءٌ فَجَاءَ نَاسٌ أَبَا بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقَ فَقَالُوا أَلَا تَرَى مَا صَنَعَتْ عَائِشَةُ؟ أَقَامَتْ بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَبِالنَّاسِ مَعَهُ وَلَيْسُوا عَلَى مَاءٍ وَلَيْسَ مَعَهُمْ مَاءٌ فَجَاءَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَاضِعٌ رَأْسَهُ عَلَى فَخِذِي قَدْ نَامَ فَقَالَ حَبَسْتِ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَالنَّاسَ وَلَيْسُوا عَلَى مَاءٍ وَلَيْسَ مَعَهُمْ مَاءٌ؟ فَعَاتَبَنِي أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَقَالَ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ أَنْ يَقُولَ وَجَعَلَ يَطْعُنُ بِيَدِهِ فِي خَاصِرَتِي فَلَا يَمْنَعُنِي مِنَ التَّحَرُّكِ إِلَّا مَكَانُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَنَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ حَتَّى أَصْبَحَ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ آيَةَ التَّيَمُّمِ فَتَيَمَّمُوا»

title: null
chain_en: Aḥmad b. ʿAlī b. al-Muthanná > ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿUmar al-Qawārīrī > Yaḥyá al-Qaṭṭān > ʿAwf > Abū Rajāʾ > ʿImrān b. Ḥuṣayn
body_en: [Machine] We were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  on a journey, and we traveled at night until it was late in the night. Then we experienced this incident, and there is no better incident for travelers than this. None of us woke up except due to the heat of the sun. He (the narrator) said, "The first to wake up was so and so, then so and so, then so and so." And they were known as Abu Rajaa's group, but Owf forgot them. Then Umar ibn Al-Khattab, the fourth one, woke up. He (the narrator) said, "When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to sleep, we would not wake him up until he woke up, because we did not know what might happen to him in his sleep." He (the narrator) said, "So when Umar woke up and saw what had befallen the people, he exclaimed and raised his voice in takbeer (saying Allahu Akbar), and he continued to exclaim and raise his voice in takbeer until the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  woke up due to his voice. When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  woke up, he complained about what had happened to them, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'No harm or danger, proceed.' So he (Umar) traveled a short distance and then stopped. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  descended and called for water, performed ablution, and the call to prayer was announced. He led the people in prayer. When he completed his prayer, he saw a man who had not prayed with the rest of the people. He said, 'What prevented you, O so and so, from praying with the people?' He said, 'O Messenger of Allah, I was experiencing sexual impurity and I did not have water.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Go and use the desert sand, for it will suffice you.' Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  traveled, and the people complained to him about their thirst. So he descended and called for so and so, who was known as Abu Rajaa, and Owf forgot about him, and he called for Ali. He said, 'Go and fetch us water.' So they met a woman carrying water on a camel. They said to her, 'Where is the water?' She said, 'I made a promise to provide water at this hour yesterday, but we are out.' They said, 'Then go,' and she said, 'Where to?' They said, 'To the Messenger of Allah ﷺ .' She said, 'Is this the one they call As-Saabi?' They said, 'Yes, that is the one.' So they brought her to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and informed him about it. He (the narrator) said, 'They dismounted her from her camel, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  called for a container and emptied the water from the mouths of the two water skins. He splashed their openings and released the knot of the water container. Then he called out to the people to drink. So he gave water to whomever he wished and they drank. Finally, he said to the one who had experienced sexual impurity, 'Go, and may it suffice you.' He said, 'By Allah, it did indeed relieve me of the need, but it seems to us that the water was more plentiful than when we first started. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Gather food for her.' So he collected some dates, flour, and barley until they had gathered a lot of food. They placed it in a garment and carried it on her camel. And they placed the garment between her hands. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to her, 'You know that we did not take anything of your water, but it was Allah who provided it for us.' She went to her people, and they asked her, 'What detained you, O so and so?' She said, 'It is amazing, two men met me and took me to the one they call As-Saabi, and he did such and such to me. By Allah, it seems that he is more skilled in magic than anyone between this and that.' Then she said to her people, 'By Allah, these people invite you to Islam, so is there any Islam for you?' So the people obeyed her and entered into Islam."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْمُثَنَّى قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ الْقَوَارِيرِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى الْقَطَّانُ حَدَّثَنَا عَوْفٌ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو رَجَاءٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عِمْرَانُ بْنُ حُصَيْنٍ قَالَ
body: كُنَّا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي سَفَرٍ وَإِنَّا سِرْنَا لَيْلَةً حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَ مِنْ آخِرِ اللَّيْلِ وَقَعْنَا تِلْكَ الْوَقْعَةَ وَلَا وَقْعَةَ أَحْلَى عِنْدَ الْمُسَافِرِ مِنْهَا فَمَا أَيْقَظَنَا إِلَّا حَرُّ الشَّمْسِ قَالَ وَكَانَ أَوَّلُ مَنِ اسْتَيْقَظَ فُلَانٌ ثُمَّ فُلَانٌ ثُمَّ فُلَانٌ وَكَانَ يُسَمِّيهِمْ أَبُو رَجَاءٍ وَنَسِيَهُمْ عَوْفٌ ثُمَّ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ الرَّابِعُ قَالَ وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا نَامَ لَمْ نُوقِظْهُ حَتَّى يَكُونَ هُوَ يَسْتَيْقِظُ لَأَنَّا لَا نَدْرِي مَا يَحْدُثُ لَهُ فِي نَوْمِهِ قَالَ فَلَمَّا اسْتَيْقَظَ عُمَرُ وَرَأَى مَا أَصَابَ النَّاسَ قَالَ وَكَانَ رَجُلًا أَجْوَفَ جَلِيدًا قَالَ فَكَبَّرَ وَرَفَعَ صَوْتَهُ فَمَا زَالَ يُكَبِّرُ وَيَرْفَعُ صَوْتَهُ بِالتَّكْبِيرِ حَتَّى اسْتَيْقَظَ بِصَوْتِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَلَمَّا اسْتَيْقَظَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ شَكَوَا الَّذِي أَصَابَهُمْ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَا ضَيْرَ أَوْ لَا يَضِيرُ ارْتَحِلُوا» فَسَارَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ ثُمَّ نَزَلَ فَدَعَا بِمَاءٍ فَتَوَضَّأَ وَنُودِيَ بِالصَّلَاةِ فَصَلَّى بِالنَّاسِ فَلَمَّا انْفَتَلَ مِنْ صَلَاتِهِ إِذَا هُوَ بِرَجُلٍ مُعْتَزِلٍ لَمْ يُصَلِّ مَعَ الْقَوْمِ قَالَ «مَا مَنَعَكَ يَا فُلَانُ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ مَعَ الْقَوْمِ؟ » قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَصَابَتْنِي جَنَابَةٌ وَلَا مَاءَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «عَلَيْكَ بِالصَّعِيدِ فَإِنَّهُ يَكْفِيكَ» ثُمَّ سَارَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَاشْتَكَى إِلَيْهِ النَّاسُ الْعَطَشَ قَالَ فَنَزَلَ فَدَعَا فُلَانًا وَكَانَ يُسَمِّيهِ أَبُو رَجَاءٍ وَنَسِيَهُ عَوْفٌ وَدَعَا عَلِيًّا فَقَالَ «اذْهَبَا فَابْغِيَا لَنَا الْمَاءَ» فَلَقِيَا امْرَأَةً بَيْنَ مَزَادَتَيْنِ أَوْ سَطِيحَتَيْنِ مِنْ مَاءٍ عَلَى بَعِيرٍ لَهَا فَقَالَا لَهَا أَيْنَ الْمَاءُ؟ قَالَتْ عَهْدِي بِالْمَاءِ أَمْسِ هَذِهِ السَّاعَةَ وَنَفَرُنَا خُلُوفٌ قَالَ فَقَالَا لَهَا انْطَلِقِي إِذًا قَالَتْ إِلَى أَيْنَ؟ قَالَا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَتْ هَذَا الَّذِي يُقَالُ لَهُ الصَّابِي؟ قَالَا هُوَ الَّذِي تَعْنِينَ فَانْطَلِقِي إِذًا فَجَاءَا بِهَا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَحَدَّثَاهُ الْحَدِيثَ قَالَ فَاسْتَنْزَلُوهَا عَنْ بَعِيرِهَا وَدَعَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِإِنَاءٍ فَأَفْرَغَ فِيهِ مِنْ أَفْوَاهِ الْمَزَادَتَيْنِ أَوِ السَّطِيحَتَيْنِ وَأَوْكَأَ أَفْوَاهَهُمَا وَأَطْلَقَ الْعَزَالِي وَنُودِيَ فِي النَّاسِ أَنِ اسْتَقُوا وَاسْقُوا قَالَ فَسَقَى مَنْ شَاءَ وَاسْتَقَى مَنْ شَاءَ وَكَانَ آخِرُ ذَلِكَ أَنْ أُعْطِيَ الَّذِي أَصَابَتْهُ الْجَنَابَةُ إِنَاءً مِنْ مَاءٍ فَقَالَ «اذْهَبْ فَأَفْرِغْهُ عَلَيْكَ» قَالَ وَهِيَ قَائِمَةٌ تَنْظُرُ إِلَى مَا يَفْعَلُ بِمَائِهَا قَالَ وَايْمُ اللَّهِ لَقَدْ أُقْلِعَ عَنْهَا حِينَ أُقْلِعَ وَإِنَّهُ لَيُخَيَّلُ لَنَا أَنَّهَا أَشَدُّ مَلْئًا مِنْهَا حِينَ ابْتُدِئَ فِيهَا فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «اجْمَعُوا لَهَا طَعَامًا» قَالَ فَجَمَعَ لَهَا مِنْ بَيْنِ عَجْوَةٍ وَدَقِيقَةٍ وَسَوِيقَةٍ حَتَّى جَمَعُوا لَهَا طَعَامًا كَثِيرًا وَجَعَلُوهُ فِي ثَوْبٍ وَحَمَلُوهَا عَلَى بَعِيرِهَا وَوَضَعُوا الثَّوْبَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهَا قَالَ فَقَالَ لَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «تَعْلَمِينَ أَنَّا وَاللَّهِ مَا رَزِئْنَا مِنْ مَائِكَ شَيْئًا وَلَكِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ سَقَانَا» قَالَ فَأَتَتْ أَهْلَهَا وَقَدِ احْتَبَسَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ فَقَالُوا مَا حَبَسَكِ يَا فُلَانَةُ؟ قَالَتِ الْعَجَبُ لَقِيَنِي رَجُلَانِ فَذَهَبَا بِي إِلَى هَذَا الَّذِي يُقَالُ لَهُ الصَّابِي فَفَعَلَ بِي كَذَا وَكَذَا الَّذِي قَدْ كَانَ فَوَاللَّهِ إِنَّهُ لَأَسْحَرُ مَنْ بَيْنَ هَذِهِ إِلَى هَذِهِ أَوْ إِنَّهُ لِرَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ حَقًّا قَالَ فَكَانَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ يُغِيرُونَ عَلَى مَنْ حَوْلَهَا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ وَلَا يُصِيبُونَ الصِّرْمَ الَّذِي هِيَ فِيهِ فَقَالَتْ لِقَوْمِهَا وَاللَّهِ هَؤُلَاءِ الْقَوْمُ يَدَعُونَكُمْ عَمْدًا فَهَلْ لَكُمْ فِي الْإِسْلَامِ؟ فَأَطَاعُوهَا فَدَخَلُوا فِي الْإِسْلَام

title: null
chain_en: al-Faḍl b. al-Ḥubāb > Musaddad b. Musarhad > Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd > ʿAwf > Abū Rajāʾ > ʿImrān b. Ḥuṣayn
body_en: [Machine] "We were on a journey with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  until we reached the late hours of the night and then encountered that incident. There is no better incident for a traveler than that. None of us woke up except due to the intense heat of the sun that had risen. Fulan and Fulan awoke, and Abu Rajaa' used to call them by that name, but they were known as 'Awf. Then Umar ibn Al-Khattab (may Allah be pleased with him) woke up, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  would not be awakened until he himself woke up, for we did not know what would happen to him in his sleep. So when Umar woke up and saw what had happened to the people, he raised his voice with takbeer (saying Allahu Akbar) continuously. He continued to do so until the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  woke up with his voice. When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  woke up, those affected complained to him and he said, 'It is of no harm, so continue on.' He then continued on, and went a short distance before descending. He called for wudu (ablution) and performed it. Then the call to prayer was made, and he led the people in prayer. When he finished his prayer, he noticed a man who had separated himself and did not pray with the rest of the people. He asked him, 'What prevented you, O so-and-so, from praying with the people?' The man said, 'O Messenger of Allah, I was in a state of janaba (sexual impurity) and had no water.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  told him, 'Go to the desert, for it will be sufficient for you.' Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  continued on. The people complained to him of thirst, so he descended and called upon Fulan, whom Abu Rajaa' used to call, and he forgot his name, and Ali ibn Abi Talib (may Allah be pleased with him) and said, 'Go and bring water.' They set off and met a woman between two hills or valleys with a water container on the back of her camel. They asked her, 'Where is the water?' She replied, 'I made a vow with this water yesterday at this hour, and now we have run out.' They said to her, 'Go to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ .' She asked, 'Is this the one they call As-Saabi?' They replied, 'Yes, it is.' So she set off with them and they brought her to the Prophet ﷺ . He called for a container and poured the water from the mouths of the two hills or valleys into it. Then he placed their mouths back and released the 'Azaliyyah water (rainwater that has gathered in a valley) and called out to the people, 'Come and drink.' He then gave water to whoever he wished. This incident concluded with him giving the one affected by janaba a container of water and saying, 'Go and pour it over yourself.' He said, 'By Allah, it felt as if the liquid was being taken away from me while I was pouring it over my body.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  then said, 'Gather some food for her.' So they gathered dates, figs, barley, and wheat for her until they had collected a large amount of food. They placed it in a cloth and carried it on her camel. They placed the cloth containing the food in front of her and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to her, 'You know, by Allah, that we did not take any of your water. Rather, it is Allah who provided it for us.'"
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا الْفَضْلُ بْنُ الْحُبَابِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدُ بْنُ مُسَرْهَدٍ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَوْفٌ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو رَجَاءٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عِمْرَانُ بْنُ حُصَيْنٍ قَالَ
body: كُنَّا فِي سَفَرٍ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ حَتَّى إِذَا كُنَّا فِي آخِرِ اللَّيْلِ وَقَعْنَا تِلْكَ الْوَقْعَةَ وَلَا وَقْعَةَ أَحْلَى عِنْدَ الْمُسَافِرِ مِنْهَا فَمَا أَيْقَظَنَا إِلَّا حَرُّ الشَّمْسِ فَاسْتَيْقَظَ فُلَانٌ وَفُلَانٌ وَكَانَ يُسَمِّيهِمْ أَبُو رَجَاءٍ وَنَسِيَهُمْ عَوْفٌ ثُمَّ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ الرَّابِعُ وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا نَامَ لَمْ يُوقَظْ حَتَّى يَكُونَ هُوَ يَسْتَيْقِظُ لَأَنَّا لَا نَدْرِي مَا يَحْدُثُ لَهُ فِي النَّوْمِ فَلَمَّا اسْتَيْقَظَ عُمَرُ رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ وَرَأَى مَا أَصَابَ النَّاسَ وَكَانَ رَجُلًا جَلِيدًا فَكَبَّرَ وَرَفَعَ صَوْتَهُ بِالتَّكْبِيرِ فَمَا زَالَ يُكَبِّرُ وَيَرْفَعُ صَوْتَهُ بِالتَّكْبِيرِ حَتَّى اسْتَيْقَظَ بِصَوْتِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَلَمَّا اسْتَيْقَظَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ شَكَوْا إِلَيْهِ الَّذِي أَصَابَهُمْ فَقَالَ «لَا يَضِيرُ فَارْتَحِلُوا» وَارْتَحَلَ فَسَارَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ ثُمَّ نَزَلَ فَدَعَا بِالْوَضُوءِ فَتَوَضَّأَ فَنُودِيَ بِالصَّلَاةِ فَصَلَّى بِالنَّاسِ فَلَمَّا انْفَتَلَ مِنْ صَلَاتِهِ فَإِذَا هُوَ بِرَجُلٍ مُعْتَزِلٍ لَمْ يُصَلِّ مَعَ الْقَوْمِ فَقَالَ «مَا مَنَعَكَ يَا فُلَانُ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ مَعَ الْقَوْمِ؟ » فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَصَابَتْنِي جَنَابَةٌ وَلَا مَاءَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «عَلَيْكَ بِالصَّعِيدِ فَإِنَّهُ يَكْفِيكَ» ثُمَّ سَارَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَشَكَا النَّاسُ إِلَيْهِ الْعَطَشَ فَنَزَلَ فَدَعَا فُلَانًا وَكَانَ يُسَمِّيهِ أَبُو رَجَاءٍ وَنَسِيَهُ عَوْفٌ وَدَعَا عَلِيًّا رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ وَقَالَ «اذْهَبَا فَأَتَيَا بِالْمَاءِ» فَانْطَلَقَا فَاسْتَقْبَلَتْهُمَا امْرَأَةٌ بَيْنَ مَزَادَتَيْنِ أَوْ سَطِيحَتَيْنِ مِنْ مَاءٍ عَلَى بَعِيرٍ لَهَا وَقَالَا لَهَا أَيْنَ الْمَاءُ؟ فَقَالَتْ عَهْدِي بِالْمَاءِ أَمْسِ هَذِهِ السَّاعَةَ وَنَفَرُنَا خُلُوفٌ قَالَا لَهَا انْطَلِقِي قَالَتْ إِلَى أَيْنَ؟ قَالَا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَتْ هَذَا الَّذِي يُقَالُ لَهُ الصَّابِي؟ قَالَا هُوَ الَّذِي تَعْنِينَ فَانْطَلِقِي وَجَاءَا بِهَا إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَاسْتَنْزَلُوهَا عَنْ بَعِيرِهَا وَدَعَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِإِنَاءٍ فَأَفْرَغَ فِيهِ مِنْ أَفْوَاهِ الْمَزَادَتَيْنِ أَوِ السَّطِيحَتَيْنِ وَأَوْكَأَ أَفْوَاهَهُمَا وَأَطْلَقَ الْعَزَالِي وَنُودِيَ فِي النَّاسِ أَنِ اسْتَقُوا وَاسْقُوا قَالَ فَسَقَى مَنْ شَاءَ وَاسْتَسْقَى مَنْ شَاءَ وَكَانَ آخِرُ ذَلِكَ أَنْ أَعْطَى الَّذِي أَصَابَتْهُ الْجَنَابَةُ إِنَاءً مِنْ مَاءٍ فَقَالَ «اذْهَبْ فَأَفْرِغْهُ عَلَيْكَ» قَالَ وَهِيَ قَائِمَةٌ تَنْظُرُ إِلَى مَا يَفْعَلُ بِمَائِهَا قَالَ وَايْمُ اللَّهِ لَقَدْ أُقْلِعَ عَنْهَا حِينَ أُقْلِعَ وَإِنَّهُ لَيُخَيَّلُ إِلَيْنَا أَنَّهَا أَشَدُّ مَلْئًا مِنْهَا حِينَ ابْتُدِئَ فِيهَا فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «اجْمَعُوا لَهَا طَعَامًا» فَجَمَعَ لَهَا مِنْ تَمْرٍ وَعَجْوَةٍ وَدَقِيقَةٍ وَسَوِيقَةٍ حَتَّى جَمَعُوا لَهَا طَعَامًا كَثِيرًا وَجَعَلُوهُ فِي ثَوْبٍ وَحَمَلُوهَا عَلَى بَعِيرِهَا وَوَضَعُوا الثَّوْبَ الَّذِي فِيهِ الطَّعَامُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهَا فَقَالَ لَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «تَعْلَمِينَ وَاللَّهِ مَا رَزَأْنَا مِنْ مَائِكِ شَيْئًا وَلَكِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الَّذِي سَقَانَا»

title: ذِكْرُ وَصْفِ التَّيَمُّمِ الَّذِي يَجُوزُ أَدَاءُ الصَّلَاةِ بِهِ عِنْدَ إِعْوَازِ الْمَاءِ
chain_en: Abū Yaʿlá > Muḥammad b. al-Minhāl al-Ḍarīr > Yazīd b. Zurayʿ > Saʿīd b. Abū ʿArūbah > Qatādah > ʿAzrah > Saʿīd b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Abzá from his father > ʿAmmār b. Yāsir
body_en: I asked the Prophet ﷺ about tayammum. He commanded me to strike only one stroke (i.e. the strike the ground) for (wiping) the face and the hands. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 327)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو يَعْلَى قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمِنْهَالِ الضَّرِيرُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ عَزْرَةَ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبْزَى عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ يَاسِرٍ قَالَ
body: سَأَلْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ عَنِ التَّيَمُّمِ «فَأَمَرَنِي بِالْوَجْهِ وَالْكَفَّيْنِ ضَرْبَةً وَاحِدَةً»

title: ذِكْرُ خَبَرٍ ثَانٍ يُصَرِّحُ بِأَنَّ مَسْحَ الذِّرَاعَيْنِ فِي التَّيَمُّمِ غَيْرُ وَاجِبٍ
chain_en: Muḥammad b. Isḥāq b. Ibrāhīm a freed slave of Thaqīf > Isḥāq b. Ibrāhīm al-Ḥanẓalī > Abū Muʿāwiyah And Yaʿlá b. ʿUbayd > al-Aʿmash > Shaqīq
body_en: [Machine] "I was sitting with Abdullah and Abu Musa. Abu Musa said, 'O Abu Abdur-Rahman, if a person cannot find water, should he still pray?' I said, 'No.' Abu Musa said, 'Do you not remember the statement of Ammar to Umar? The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  sent both of us, and I became junub and had to perform tayammum with soil. Then I went to the Prophet ﷺ  and informed him about it, and he said, 'It would have been sufficient for you to do this,' and he struck his hand on the ground and rubbed his face and hands with it.'"  I have not seen Umar compromising on this. He said, 'What will you do with this verse: "So if you do not find water, then purify yourselves with clean earth"?' He said, 'If we granted permission to them in this matter, then whenever one of them found cold water, he would perform tayammum with the earth.' Ya'la narrated this from Al-A'mash who said, 'I said to my brother (Ammar), "This was only because of this."'
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ مَوْلَى ثَقِيفٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ وَيَعْلَى بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ قَالَا حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ عَنْ شَقِيقٍ قَالَ
body: كُنْتُ جَالِسًا مَعَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَأَبِي مُوسَى فَقَالَ أَبُو مُوسَى يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّجُلُ يُجْنِبُ فَلَا يَجِدُ الْمَاءَ أَيُصَلِّي؟ فَقَالَ لَا فَقَالَ أَمَا تَذْكُرُ قَوْلَ عَمَّارٍ لِعُمَرَ بَعَثَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنَا وَأَنْتَ فَأَجْنَبْتُ فَتَمَعَّكْتُ فِي التُّرَابِ فَأَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لَهُ فَقَالَ «كَانَ يَكْفِيكَ هَكَذَا وَضَرَبَ بِيَدِهِ الْأَرْضَ فَمَسَحَ وَجْهَهُ وَكَفَّيْهِ» فَقَالَ لَمْ أَرَ عُمَرَ قَنَعَ بِذَلِكَ قَالَ فَمَا تَصْنَعُ بِهَذِهِ الْآيَةِ {فَلَمْ تَجِدُوا مَاءً فَتَيَمَّمُوا صَعِيدًا طَيِّبًا} فَقَالَ «أَمَا إِنَّا لَوْ رَخَّصْنَا لَهُمْ فِي هَذَا لَكَانَ أَحَدُهُمْ إِذَا وَجَدَ بَرْدَ الْمَاءِ تَيَمَّمَ بِالصَّعِيدِ» زَادَ يَعْلَى قَالَ الْأَعْمَشُ فَقُلْتُ لِشَقِيقٍ فَلَمْ يَكُنْ هَذَا إِلَّا لِهَذَا

chain_en: ʿUmar b. Muḥammad al-Hamdānī > Bishr b. Muʿādh al-ʿAqadī > ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Ziyād > Sulaymān al-Aʿmash > Shaqīq b. Salamah > Abū Mūsá Liʿabd Allāh b. Masʿūd Law > Junub Lam Yajid al-Māʾ Shahr Lam Yuṣal > ʿAbdullāh Lā > Abū Mūsá Amā Tadhkur Ḥīn
body_en: [Machine] "Did a person who was in a state of sexual impurity for a month not offer prayer? Abdullah said no. Abu Musa said, 'Do you not remember when Ammar ibn Yasir said to Umar, 'O Amir al-Mu'minin, do you not fear Allah? Do you not remember when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  sent both you and me to take care of the camels and I was affected by major impurity (janabah)? I then purified myself with soil. When I returned to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and informed him, he said, 'It would have been sufficient for you to say this,' and he hit his hand on the ground and wiped his face and hands.' Abdullah said, 'No doubt, I never saw Umar content with this.' Abu Musa said, 'What about this verse in Surah An-Nisa, 'If you can't find water, then perform Tayammum (dry ablution) with clean earth,' Abdullah replied, 'If we had allowed them to do so, as soon as water came into contact with their skin, they would have performed Tayammum.'"
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْهَمْدَانِيُّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَقَدِيُّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ بْنُ زِيَادٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ الْأَعْمَشُ عَنْ شَقِيقِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو مُوسَى لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ لَوْ
body: أَنَّ جُنُبًا لَمْ يَجِدِ الْمَاءَ شَهْرًا لَمْ يُصَلِّ؟ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ لَا قَالَ أَبُو مُوسَى أَمَا تَذْكُرُ حِينَ قَالَ عَمَّارُ بْنُ يَاسِرٍ لِعُمَرَ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَلَا تَتَّقِي اللَّهَ أَلَا تَذْكُرُ حِينَ بَعَثَنِي وَإِيَّاكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي الْإِبِلِ فَأَصَابَتْنِي جَنَابَةٌ فَتَمَعَّكْتُ فِي التُّرَابِ فَلَمَّا رَجَعْتُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَخْبَرْتُهُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِنَّمَا كَانَ يَكْفِيكَ أَنْ تَقُولَ هَكَذَا وَضَرَبَ بِيَدِهِ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ وَمَسَحَ وَجْهَهُ وَكَفَّيْهِ» قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ لَا جَرَمَ مَا رَأَيْتُ عُمَرَ قَنَعَ بِذَلِكَ قَالَ أَبُو مُوسَى فَكَيْفَ بِهَذِهِ الْآيَةِ فِي سُورَةِ النِّسَاءِ {فَلَمْ تَجِدُوا مَاءً فَتَيَمَّمُوا} صَعِيدًا طَيِّبًا فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ «إِنَّا لَوْ رَخَّصْنَا لَهُمْ فِي ذَلِكَ يُوشِكُ إِذَا بَرَدَ عَلَى جِلْدِ أَحَدِهِمُ الْمَاءُ أَنْ يَتَيَمَّمَ»

chain_en: ʿUmar b. Muḥammad al-Hamdānī > Muḥammad b. Bashhār > Muḥammad b. Jaʿfar > Shuʿbah > al-Ḥakam > Dhar > Ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Abzá from his father > a man Atá ʿUmar b. al-Khaṭṭāb > Innī Ajnabt Falam Ajid al-Māʾ > ʿUmar Lā Tuṣal > ʿAmmār Amā Tadhkur Yā Amīr al-Muʾminīn Idh
body_en: A man came to 'Umar bin khattab and said: "I became impure following sexual emission and cannot find any water." 'Umar said to him: "Do not pray." But 'Ammar bin Yasir said: "Do you not remember, O Commander of the Believers, when you and I were on a military expedition and we became sexually impure and could not find water? As for you, you did not pray, but I rolled in the dust and then prayed. When I came to the Prophet and told him what had happened, he said: 'It would have been enough for you (to do this).' (Then demonstrating) the Prophet struck the ground with his hands, then blew on hem, and wiped his face and palms with them." (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 569)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْهَمْدَانِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ ذَرٍّ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبْزَى عَنْ أَبِيهِ أَنَّ رَجُلًا أَتَى عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ فَقَالَ إِنِّي أَجْنَبْتُ فَلَمْ أَجِدِ الْمَاءَ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ لَا تُصَلِّ فَقَالَ
body: عَمَّارٌ أَمَا تَذْكُرُ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِذْ أَنَا وَأَنْتَ فِي سَرِيَّةٍ فَأَجْنَبْنَا فَلَمْ نَجْدِ الْمَاءَ فَأَمَّا أَنْتَ فَلَمْ تُصَلِّ وَأَمَّا أَنَا فَتَمَعَّكْتُ فِي التُّرَابِ فَصَلَّيْتُ فَلَمَّا أَتَيْنَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ ذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لَهُ فَقَالَ «إِنَّمَا كَانَ يَكْفِيكَ وَضَرَبَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ بِيَدِهِ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ نَفَخَ فِيهِمَا وَمَسَحَ بِهِمَا وَجْهَهُ وَكَفَّيْهِ»

title: ذِكْرُ خَبَرٍ ثَانٍ يُصَرِّحُ بِصِحَّةِ مَا ذَكَرْنَاهُ
chain_en: Isḥāq b. Ibrāhīm b. Ismāʿīl Bibust > al-Ḥasan b. ʿAlī al-Ḥulwānī > Yaʿlá b. ʿUbayd > al-Aʿmash > Shaqīq
body_en: [Machine] I was with Abdullah and Abu Musa, and Abu Musa said, "O Abu Abdur Rahman, if a person is in a state of major impurity and cannot find water, should they still perform prayer?" Abdullah replied, "Listen to the saying of Ammar ibn Yasir to Umar. The Prophet ﷺ sent both of us, and I was in a state of major impurity. Therefore, I performed dry ablution and joined the Prophet ﷺ. I informed him about my condition, and he said, 'That is enough for you.' He then wiped his face and hands once. I have never seen Umar disagreeing with that ruling. Umar said, 'How will you deal with this verse: 'And if you do not find water, then perform tayammum with pure earth'?' Umar said, 'If we permit them to perform tayammum in this situation, one of them, when finding cold water, will wipe himself with earth.' Al-A'mash said, 'So I said to my brother, Umar disliked it only because of this reason.'"
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بِبُسْتَ حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ عَنْ شَقِيقٍ قَالَ
body: كُنْتُ مَعَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَأَبِي مُوسَى فَقَالَ أَبُو مُوسَى يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّجُلُ يُجْنِبُ فَلَا يَجِدُ الْمَاءَ يُصَلِّي؟ فَقَالَ تَسْمَعُ قَوْلَ عَمَّارِ بْنِ يَاسِرٍ لِعُمَرَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ بَعَثَنَا أَنَا وَأَنْتَ فَأَجْنَبْتُ فَتَمَعَّكْتُ بِالصَّعِيدِ فَأَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ فَقَالَ «إِنَّمَا يَكْفِيكَ هَكَذَا وَمَسَحَ وَجْهَهُ وَكَفَّيْهِ وَاحِدَةً» فَقَالَ إِنِّي لَمْ أَرَ عُمَرَ قَنَعَ بِذَلِكَ فَقَالَ كَيْفَ تَصْنَعُونَ بِهَذِهِ الْآيَةِ؟ {فَلَمْ تَجِدُوا مَاءً فَتَيَمَّمُوا صَعِيدًا طَيِّبًا} قَالَ «لَوْ رَخَّصْنَا لَهُمْ فِي هَذِهِ كَانَ أَحَدُهُمْ إِذَا وَجَدَ الْمَاءَ الْبَارِدَ يَمْسَحُ بِالصَّعِيدِ» قَالَ الْأَعْمَشُ فَقُلْتُ لِشَقِيقٍ مَا كَرِهَهُ إِلَّا لِهَذَا

title: ذِكْرُ الْأَمْرِ بِالِاقْتِصَارِ فِي التَّيَمُّمِ بِالْكَفَّيْنِ مَعَ الْوَجْهِ دُونَ السَّاعِدَيْنِ بِالضَّرْبَتَيْنِ
chain_en: al-Ḥasan b. Sufyān > Muḥammad b. al-Minhāl al-Ḍarīr > Yazīd b. Zurayʿ > Saʿīd > Qatādah > ʿAzrah > Saʿīd b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Abzá from his father > ʿAmmār b. Yāsir
body_en: I asked the Prophet ﷺ about tayammum. He commanded me to strike only one stroke (i.e. the strike the ground) for (wiping) the face and the hands. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 327)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ سُفْيَانَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمِنْهَالِ الضَّرِيرُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ عَزْرَةَ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبْزَى عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ يَاسِرٍ قَالَ
body: سَأَلْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ عَنِ التَّيَمُّمِ؟ «فَأَمَرَنِي بِالْوَجْهِ وَالْكَفَّيْنِ ضَرْبَةً وَاحِدَةً»

title: ذِكْرُ اسْتِحْبَابِ النَّفْخِ فِي الْيَدَيْنِ بَعْدَ ضَرْبِهِمَا عَلَى الصَّعِيدِ لِلتَّيَمُّمِ

(Then demonstrating) the Prophet struck the ground with his hands, then blew on hem, and wiped his face and palms with them." (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 569)
